name: Software stack: compilers and pulse level
blurb: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system.

touchstones.text: pulse-level programming and OpenQASM compilation for quantum processors
noise-aware qubit mapping and routing on limited connectivity
transpiler optimisation for native gate sets
